chunks: Salih ibn 'Uqba from Yunus al-Shaybani who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'If a drop of blood comes out in the seed?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The drop is a tenth of the seed, regarding it is twenty-two Dinars.' I said, 'So if it drops two drops?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Twenty-four Dinars.' He said. I said, 'So if it drops three?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Twenty-six Dinars.' I said, 'So four?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Twenty-eight Dinars; and regarding five is thirty Dinars; and whatever increases upon the half, so it is based upon the accounting of that until it becomes a clot. So when it becomes a clot, so with regards to it is forty (Dinars).'

So Abu Shibl asked him (peace be upon him), and Abu Shibl informed us saying, 'Yunus was present and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) informed him with the wergilds.' I said, 'So if the seed comes out submerged in the blood?' So he (peace be upon him) said to me: 'So it has clotted, if it was clear blood. Therefore with regards to it is forty Dinars; and if it was black blood, so there is nothing upon it except for the reprimanding, because whatever was from clear blood, so that is for the child, and whatever was from the black blood, so that is from the inside.'

Abu Shibl said, 'So if the clot is such that there happen to be in it resembling the veins from the flesh?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Forty-two and the one-tenth.' I said, 'So if the tenth is forty-four?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'No! But rather, it is a tenth of the lump, because its one-tenth has gone. So whatever is increased, it increased until it reaches the sixty.'

I said, 'So what is your view regarding the lump with nodes resembling the dry bones?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'So that is the bone. It is like that in the beginning, what is the beginning of (the formation of) the bones, by five months. Therefore, with regards to it is forty Dinars. So if it is additional, so it increases by four, four, until it is completed at eighty.'

I said, 'And similar to that when the bones attain flesh?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is like that.' I said, 'So when she is punched (in the belly) and the child is dropped, and it is not known whether it was alive, or not?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Far be it! O Abu Shibl, when five months elapse, so the life has come into it, and the wergild is Obligated.'
ai.seo_question: What is the financial compensation for abortion at different stages of fetal development in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines a precise, graduated scale of *diyah* (blood money) for fetal abortion, distinguishing between clear blood (*dam safi*) which incurs full liability, and dark blood from the womb which requires only discretionary punishment (*ta'zir*). This narration is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for determining the threshold of ensoulment and full personhood, specifically highlighting the significance of the five-month mark when life is firmly established.
